events.body:
## Outcome

Keep the expanded product fast, navigable, readable, and predictable through measured budgets rather than subjective polish claims.

## Implementation

- Set checked-in local and remote budgets for startup, repository browse, fuzzy search, diff render, graph render, command actions, and status refresh.
- Add deterministic fuzzy-search relevance fixtures and commit-graph correctness checks.
- Cover keyboard navigation, command palette, exact-command copy, dark and light themes, empty/loading/error states, and narrow viewports.
- Add accessible names, focus order, contrast, reduced motion, and screen-reader snapshots for every new surface.
- Run visual regression and performance tests for large diffs, long histories, many mirrors, and offline local-first operation.

## Acceptance criteria

- A budget regression fails the owning continuous-integration job with the measured delta.
- Local cached repository actions remain usable with every network route disabled.
- Fuzzy-search ordering and graph topology are deterministic.
- No new surface requires a pointer or color alone.
- The terminology contract from #460 passes in every snapshot.

## Dependencies

Uses the complete test portfolio in #434 and vocabulary contract in #460.

## Verification

Run performance and visual fixtures on fixed data sets twice, compare normalized metrics and images, disable all routes for local flows, and inject keyboard, contrast, focus, and terminology regressions.
